title: Minerals Resource Rent Tax Amendment (Protecting Revenue) Bill 2013

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would limit mining royalty credits against the Minerals Resource Rent Tax by disregarding royalty increases introduced after the specified 1 July 2011 benchmark.
Credits would be calculated without later royalty increases, and the tax’s explanatory provision would refer to Commonwealth, state and territory royalty amounts at that benchmark.
The changes would apply to assessments from 2012-13, the tax’s first year, and the amending legislation would commence on the day of Royal Assent.
changes: Royalty credit calculations would exclude increases occurring after 1 July 2011.
The Act’s overview would specify royalty amounts in force on the benchmark date.
Application would extend back to the first year of Minerals Resource Rent Tax assessments.
summary.affected: Mining companies subject to the Minerals Resource Rent Tax are affected.
